value.rationale: The Frucht graph is a canonical smallest asymmetric cubic graph and the exact all-coefficient-field persistence of its entire induced-component-size filtration was not implied by known ordinary independence results. The degree-five barcode has a long-lived singleton plus sixteen immediate deaths and thirty-two late births; mixed-degree homology at r=5 and an exact r=2 sphere add motivated topological structure.
